items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: And well as I know of, a fellow they called, Tio was in town here. He hadn't left then. He was working with a couple of the bands.

ctx.x: No, before you played. Before I played anything.

Before you took up any of the- Manion Perez and they had this Clover band that had been a long time ago. Cloverleaf. Cloverleaf band. That had been way back and they had, at the time they had the old Excelsior band. Old Excelsior band. Yeah, I heard of that. I never got to hear it. That was a long time ago. That was before I started with music. I used to like music because I was a music lover. I always listened. If not I'd follow the bands around, you know what I mean? Yeah. And that's how I got to like the…
When did you start in music? What was your first instrument?
